test.describe('Promo Pulse Dashboard - Overview Page', () => {
  // Assuming login is handled separately, start from landing page
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    // Login and navigate to landing page
    await page.goto('http://135.235.180.85:30000/login');
    await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Email' }).fill('user@example.com'); // Replace with valid email
    await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Password' }).fill('SecurePassword123!'); // Replace with valid password
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'LOGIN' }).click();
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle'); // Give time for authentication
    
    // Wait for landing page to load
    await page.waitForURL('**/landingpage');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL('http://135.235.180.85:30000/landingpage');
    
    // Navigate to connections page
    await page.goto('http://135.235.180.85:30000/1bccccfd-4981-49c9-8f81-59410530338b/etl/connections');
  });

  test('Page Load & Basic Verification', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify page title, URL, and main heading
    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(/Promo Pulse - AI Decision Cockpit/);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL('http://135.235.180.85:30000/landingpage');

    // Confirm main heading
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promo Pulse - AI Decision Cockpit' })).toBeVisible();

    // Confirm KPI Navigator (left panel), Filter Bar, Insights Section, and main content are visible
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="kpi-navigator"]')).toBeVisible(); // Assuming testid
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="filter-bar"]')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="insights-section"]')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="main-content"]')).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('KPI Navigator (Left Panel)', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify all KPI cards are displayed
    const kpiCards = ['Total Brands', 'Total Customers', 'Volume Sold'];
    for (const kpi of kpiCards) {
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: kpi })).toBeVisible();
    }

    // Check that KPI values are numeric and greater than 0
    const totalBrandsValue = await page.locator('[data-testid="total-brands-value"]').textContent();
    expect(parseInt(totalBrandsValue)).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const totalCustomersValue = await page.locator('[data-testid="total-customers-value"]').textContent();
    expect(parseInt(totalCustomersValue)).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const volumeSoldValue = await page.locator('[data-testid="volume-sold-value"]').textContent();
    expect(parseFloat(volumeSoldValue)).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Test clicking each KPI card and verify it opens the expected module/detail view
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Total Brands' }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/brands/); // Assuming URL changes
    await page.goBack();

    // Repeat for other KPI cards
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Total Customers' }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/customers/);
    await page.goBack();

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Volume Sold' }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/volume/);
  });

  test('Global Filter Bar', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify filters are present

## Project brief: RGM / PromoPulse dashboard demo

**PromoPulse** is a web-based **RGM dashboard application** used to visualize promotion and revenue-growth-related business metrics. The app is primarily a **dashboard/reporting UI** that consumes data from backend APIs and upstream data-engineering pipelines rather than calculating KPI values in the frontend.

### Main user flow
1. User lands on the **login page**.
2. After login, user is redirected to a **landing page**.
3. From the landing page, the user selects an app from available apps.
4. For this demo, the selected app is **RGM PromoPulse**.
5. Opening PromoPulse leads to the main dashboard experience.

### Main modules/pages in the application
The dashboard contains these major sections/pages:
- **Overview**
- **Promo Overview**
- **Brand Overview**
- **Channel Overview**
- **Customer Overview**

These pages show business data in:
- **Graph/chart format**
- **Tabular/data format**
- **KPI cards / insight cards**

### Core functionality observed
- **Filters** are a major part of the app.
- Mentioned filters include:
  - **Region**
  - **Channel**
  - likely **time-period options** such as:
    - monthly
    - quarterly
    - yearly
- Applying filters changes the displayed dashboard data, graphs, and cards.
- The app contains **KPI navigator/cards** and **insight cards**.
- There is also a **“View All”** style navigation for seeing all insight cards for a KPI area.

### KPIs / data themes mentioned
The transcript references several KPI/data concepts, including:
- **Total trade spend**
- **Incremental revenue**
- **Average ROI**
- **Total brands**
- **Gross revenue**
- **List price**
- **Customer revenue concentration**
- **Spend strategy / spend delta**
- KPI counts / total insights

### Important data behavior / implementation notes
These are important for testing context:
- The **frontend mostly displays data returned by APIs**.
- **Calculations/formulas are handled by backend/data-engineering teams**, not by the UI.
- Data is said to come from **data engineering layers** such as:
  - bronze
  - silver
  - gold
- At least in the demo, some values/pages may still use **dummy data or hardcoded demo data**.
- Team members repeatedly mentioned that exact KPI formulas and region-specific logic were **not fully clarified in the UI demo** and need supporting documents from BA/data/backend teams.
- The current data shown in the demo was mentioned as **India-specific** in at least one discussion, though there were questions about supporting other regions/global markets.

### Testing-relevant concerns raised in the meeting
The demo discussion highlighted several validation points that Playwright testing should cover:

#### UI and navigation
- Login to landing page flow
- App selection flow
- Navigation across:
  - Overview
  - Promo Overview
  - Brand Overview
  - Channel Overview
  - Customer Overview

#### Filters
- Region filter behavior
- Channel filter behavior
- Time-period filter behavior:
  - monthly
  - quarterly
  - yearly
- Verify that applying filters updates graphs/cards/tables

#### Data rendering
- KPI cards load correctly
- Insight cards load correctly
- “View all insights” behavior works
- Graphs and tables render without breaking
- Data changes when filters change

#### Data consistency / non-functional observations
- Some data may be static/demo/hardcoded
- Need to distinguish:
  - UI validation
  - API/data-layer validation
  - formula validation
- Exact numeric correctness may depend on backend docs and source formulas, so UI tests should focus on:
  - presence
  - updates after filter changes
  - structure
  - navigation
  - response behavior

#### Refresh behavior
- The app appears to support **manual refresh**
- **Auto-refresh was discussed but not confirmed as implemented**
- Testing should verify current actual behavior rather than assume auto-refresh exists

### Risks / ambiguities from transcript
The transcript suggests the product is **partially ready from a UI perspective**, but some areas are still unclear for full validation:
- Formula definitions are not fully documented in the UI team
- Some dashboard data may be mock/demo data
- Backend/data pipeline behavior needs separate confirmation
- Transformation/injection pipeline details were discussed but not clearly finalized
- Some user stories/test cases/docs may need updates, especially for time-period options and refresh behavior

## Short version for Playwright
**PromoPulse (RGM dashboard)** is a dashboard-based web app where users log in, select the PromoPulse app, and access multiple sections: Overview, Promo Overview, Brand Overview, Channel Overview, and Customer Overview. The app displays KPI cards, insight cards, charts, and tables. Users can apply filters such as region, channel, and possibly monthly/quarterly/yearly time periods, and the UI should update accordingly. The frontend mainly renders API/backend-provided data; KPI formulas are handled in backend/data pipelines, so UI automation should primarily validate navigation, visibility, filter interactions, page rendering, card/chart/table updates, and current refresh behavior.
